<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #05060f;
  }
  body {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, #161c44 0%, #05060f 75%);
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(130, 150, 255, 0.3), 0 0 50px rgba(80, 100, 255, 0.3);
    touch-action: none;
  }
  noscript {
    color: #fff;
    font: 18px system-ui, sans-serif;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600" aria-label="Brick Breaker game"></canvas>
<noscript>Please enable JavaScript to play Brick Breaker.</noscript>
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  // ===========================================================================
  // Configuration
  // ===========================================================================
  const W = 800, H = 600;            // logical game size; the canvas is scaled to fit the window
  const HUD_H = 48;                  // height of the score bar; the playfield starts below it
  const BALL_R = 7;
  const PADDLE_H = 14;
  const PADDLE_Y = H - 48;
  const PADDLE_KEY_SPEED = 720;      // px/s when steering with the keyboard
  const MAX_BOUNCE = Math.PI / 3;    // bounce angle off the paddle's edge, measured from vertical
  const BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_TOP = 100, SIDE_MARGIN = 28;
  const SUBSTEP = 4;                 // max px the ball travels per collision sub-step (no tunnelling)
  const INTRO_TIME = 0.8;            // length of the brick drop-in animation when a level starts
  const START_LIVES = 3;
  const FONT = '"Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif';
  const MONO = 'Consolas, "SF Mono", Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace';
  const RAINBOW = ['#ff4d6d', '#ff8f3f', '#ffd23f', '#3ddc84', '#2ec5f0', '#a66bff'];

  const BRICK_TYPES = {
    r: { color: '#ff4d6d', points: 70 },
    o: { color: '#ff8f3f', points: 60 },
    y: { color: '#ffd23f', points: 50 },
    g: { color: '#3ddc84', points: 40 },
    c: { color: '#2ec5f0', points: 30 },
    b: { color: '#5b7cfa', points: 20 },
    p: { color: '#a66bff', points: 60 },
    m: { color: '#ff5fd2', points: 50 },
    S: { color: '#b9c3d6', points: 100, hits: 2 },   // silver: takes two hits
  };

  // One character per brick (see BRICK_TYPES), '.' = empty.
  const LEVELS = [
    {
      name: 'The Wall', tip: 'Clear every brick',
      speed: 360, maxSpeed: 520, paddleW: 120,
      bg: ['#0b1030', '#1a0d36'],
      map: [
        'rrrrrrrrrr',
        'oooooooooo',
        'yyyyyyyyyy',
        'gggggggggg',
        'cccccccccc',
        'bbbbbbbbbb',
      ],
    },
    {
      name: 'Invader', tip: 'Silver bricks take two hits',
      speed: 420, maxSpeed: 600, paddleW: 104,
      bg: ['#150a30', '#06202c'],
      map: [
        '..S.....S..',
        '...p...p...',
        '..ppppppp..',
        '.pp.ppp.pp.',
        'SSSSSSSSSSS',
        'm.mmmmmmm.m',
        'm.m.....m.m',
        '...SS.SS...',
      ],
    },
  ];

  // ===========================================================================
  // Canvas, storage and drawing helpers
  // ===========================================================================
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let pxScale = 1;                   // device pixels per logical pixel (shadow blur ignores transforms)

  const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => (v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v);

  const store = {
    get(key) { try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch (e) { return null; } },
    set(key, value) { try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (e) { /* storage unavailable */ } },
  };

  // Mix a #rrggbb colour towards white (amount > 0) or black (amount < 0).
  function shade(hex, amount) {
    const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
    const target = amount < 0 ? 0 : 255, k = Math.abs(amount);
    const mix = (c) => Math.round(c + (target - c) * k);
    return `rgb(${mix(n >> 16)}, ${mix((n >> 8) & 255)}, ${mix(n & 255)})`;
  }

  function gradient(x0, y0, x1, y1, colors) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x1, y1);
    colors.forEach((c, i) => g.addColorStop(i / (colors.length - 1), c));
    return g;
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function heartPath(cx, top, s) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx, top, cx - s * 0.5, top, cx - s * 0.5, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - s * 0.5, top + s * 0.6, cx, top + s * 0.75, cx, top + s);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx, top + s * 0.75, cx + s * 0.5, top + s * 0.6, cx + s * 0.5, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + s * 0.5, top, cx, top, cx, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // Paint styles are built once. Brick and ball gradients use object-local coordinates.
  const brickFill = (color) => gradient(0, 0, 0, BRICK_H, [shade(color, 0.35), color, shade(color, -0.35)]);
  const BRICK_FILLS = {};
  for (const key in BRICK_TYPES) BRICK_FILLS[key] = brickFill(BRICK_TYPES[key].color);
  const CRACKED_FILL = brickFill('#8a94aa');
  for (const lvl of LEVELS) lvl.bgFill = gradient(0, 0, 0, H, lvl.bg);
  const DANGER_FILL = gradient(0, H - 60, 0, H, ['rgba(255, 60, 110, 0)', 'rgba(255, 60, 110, 0.16)']);
  const HUD_LINE = gradient(0, 0, W, 0, RAINBOW);
  const TITLE_FILL = gradient(W / 2 - 280, 0, W / 2 + 280, 0, RAINBOW);
  const PADDLE_FILL = gradient(0, PADDLE_Y, 0, PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H, ['#a8f4ff', '#2bb8f5', '#1560c0']);
  const BALL_FILL = ctx.createRadialGradient(-2.5, -2.5, 1, 0, 0, BALL_R);
  BALL_FILL.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  BALL_FILL.addColorStop(1, '#b4e2ff');
  const STARS = Array.from({ length: 70 }, () => ({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: HUD_H + Math.random() * (H - HUD_H),
    size: Math.random() < 0.15 ? 2 : 1.2,
    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    speed: 0.8 + Math.random() * 2,
  }));

  // ===========================================================================
  // Sound: a tiny synthesiser, so the game needs no audio files
  // ===========================================================================
  const sfx = (() => {
    let ac = null, master = null;
    let muted = store.get('brickBreaker.muted') === '1';

    // Browsers only allow audio after a user gesture, so this runs on key presses / clicks.
    function unlock() {
      if (!ac) {
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AudioCtx) return;
        try {
          ac = new AudioCtx();
          master = ac.createGain();
          master.gain.value = 0.2;
          master.connect(ac.destination);
        } catch (e) {
          ac = null;
          return;
        }
      }
      if (ac.state === 'suspended') {
        const resumed = ac.resume();
        if (resumed && resumed.catch) resumed.catch(() => {});
      }
    }

    function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, endFreq = 0, delay = 0) {
      if (muted || !ac) return;
      const t = ac.currentTime + delay;
      const osc = ac.createOscillator();
      const gain = ac.createGain();
      osc.type = type;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
      if (endFreq) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq, t + dur);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + 0.01);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(master);
      osc.start(t);
      osc.stop(t + dur + 0.05);
    }

    const melody = (notes, step, dur, type, vol) =>
      notes.forEach((f, i) => tone(f, dur, type, vol, 0, i * step));

    return {
      unlock,
      get muted() { return muted; },
      toggle() {
        muted = !muted;
        store.set('brickBreaker.muted', muted ? '1' : '0');
        return muted;
      },
      launch: () => tone(420, 0.12, 'sine', 0.4, 840),
      paddle: () => tone(250, 0.09, 'square', 0.3, 330),
      wall: () => tone(170, 0.05, 'square', 0.15),
      brick: (combo) => tone(523.25 * Math.pow(2, Math.min(combo - 1, 14) / 12), 0.09, 'square', 0.25),
      metal: () => tone(1250, 0.14, 'triangle', 0.35, 900),
      lose: () => tone(440, 0.6, 'sawtooth', 0.3, 60),
      levelUp: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047], 0.11, 0.16, 'square', 0.25),
      gameOver: () => melody([392, 330, 262, 196], 0.22, 0.32, 'triangle', 0.4),
      win: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047, 784, 1047, 1319], 0.12, 0.2, 'square', 0.25),
    };
  })();

  // ===========================================================================
  // Game state
  // ===========================================================================
  const paddle = { x: (W - LEVELS[0].paddleW) / 2, y: PADDLE_Y, w: LEVELS[0].paddleW, h: PADDLE_H, flash: 0 };
  const ball = { x: W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 0 };
  const particles = [], floaters = [], trail = [];

  // States: title | serve | play | paused | dying | levelClear | gameOver | win
  let state = 'title', stateTime = 0;
  let pausedFrom = 'play', pausedStateTime = 0;
  let levelIndex = 0, level = LEVELS[0], levelTime = 0;
  let bricks = [], bricksLeft = 0;
  let score = 0, shownScore = 0, lives = START_LIVES, combo = 0;
  let best = parseInt(store.get('brickBreaker.best'), 10) || 0;
  let bestAtStart = best, newBest = false, bonusLines = [];
  let time = 0, shakeTime = 0, shakeDuration = 1, shakeStrength = 0, fireworkTimer = 0;
  let toast = null;

  function setState(next) {
    state = next;
    stateTime = 0;
  }

  function buildBricks(map) {
    const cols = Math.max(...map.map((row) => row.length));
    const bw = Math.floor((W - 2 * SIDE_MARGIN - (cols - 1) * BRICK_GAP) / cols);
    const left = Math.floor((W - (cols * bw + (cols - 1) * BRICK_GAP)) / 2);
    const list = [];
    map.forEach((row, r) => {
      [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
        const type = BRICK_TYPES[ch];
        if (!type) return;
        const hits = type.hits || 1;
        list.push({
          x: left + c * (bw + BRICK_GAP),
          y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
          w: bw, h: BRICK_H,
          type: ch, color: type.color, points: type.points,
          hits, maxHits: hits, alive: true, flash: 0, crack: null,
          delay: r * 0.05 + Math.abs(c - (cols - 1) / 2) * 0.02,   // drop-in order: top centre first
        });
      });
    });
    return list;
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Game flow
  // ===========================================================================
  function startGame() {
    score = 0;
    shownScore = 0;
    lives = START_LIVES;
    bestAtStart = best;
    newBest = false;
    loadLevel(0);
    setState('serve');
  }

  function nextLevel() {
    loadLevel(levelIndex + 1);
    setState('serve');
  }

  function loadLevel(index) {
    levelIndex = index;
    level = LEVELS[index];
    bricks = buildBricks(level.map);
    bricksLeft = bricks.length;
    levelTime = 0;
    paddle.w = level.paddleW;
    paddle.x = (W - paddle.w) / 2;
    particles.length = 0;
    floaters.length = 0;
    resetBall();
  }

  function resetBall() {
    ball.speed = level.speed;
    ball.vx = 0;
    ball.vy = 0;
    combo = 0;
    trail.length = 0;
    stickBallToPaddle();
  }

  function stickBallToPaddle() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R - 1;
  }

  function launchBall() {
    // Launch towards the steering direction if a key is held, otherwise randomly left or right.
    let dir = (rightHeld() ? 1 : 0) - (leftHeld() ? 1 : 0);
    if (!dir) dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
    const angle = dir * (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.25);
    ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    setState('play');
    sfx.launch();
  }

  function loseLife() {
    lives--;
    combo = 0;
    trail.length = 0;
    startShake(0.5, 10);
    burst(clamp(ball.x, 10, W - 10), H - 8, ['#ffffff', '#ff4d6d', '#ffd23f'], 32, 380);
    sfx.lose();
    setState('dying');
  }

  function levelComplete() {
    const bonus = 1000 * (levelIndex + 1);
    score += bonus;
    bonusLines = [`Level bonus  +${bonus}`];
    burst(ball.x, ball.y, ['#ffffff', '#7fdcff'], 24, 260);
    trail.length = 0;
    if (levelIndex === LEVELS.length - 1) {
      const lifeBonus = lives * 500;
      score += lifeBonus;
      bonusLines.push(`Lives bonus  ${lives} × 500 = +${lifeBonus}`);
      endGame('win');
    } else {
      setState('levelClear');
      sfx.levelUp();
    }
  }

  function endGame(result) {
    newBest = score > bestAtStart;
    saveBest();
    fireworkTimer = 0;
    setState(result);
    if (result === 'win') sfx.win();
    else sfx.gameOver();
  }

  function saveBest() {
    if (score > best) best = score;
    store.set('brickBreaker.best', String(best));
  }

  function togglePause() {
    if (state === 'play' || state === 'serve') {
      pausedFrom = state;
      pausedStateTime = stateTime;
      state = 'paused';
    } else if (state === 'paused') {
      state = pausedFrom;
      stateTime = pausedStateTime;
    }
  }

  function autoPause() {
    if (state === 'play') togglePause();
  }

  function toggleMute() {
    toast = { text: sfx.toggle() ? 'Sound off' : 'Sound on', t: 1.5 };
  }

  // Space / Enter / click: start, launch, resume or continue depending on the screen.
  function primaryAction() {
    switch (state) {
      case 'title':
        startGame();
        break;
      case 'serve':
        if (levelTime >= INTRO_TIME) launchBall();
        break;
      case 'paused':
        togglePause();
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        if (stateTime > 0.8) nextLevel();
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
      case 'win':
        if (stateTime > 1) startGame();
        break;
    }
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Input: keyboard and mouse (touch / pen work too, via pointer events)
  // ===========================================================================
  const keys = Object.create(null);
  const pointer = { x: W / 2, moved: false };
  const leftHeld = () => !!(keys.ArrowLeft || keys.KeyA);
  const rightHeld = () => !!(keys.ArrowRight || keys.KeyD);
  const ACTION_KEYS = ['Space', 'Enter', 'NumpadEnter', 'ArrowUp', 'KeyW'];
  const NO_SCROLL_KEYS = ['Space', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'];

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;   // leave browser shortcuts alone
    if (NO_SCROLL_KEYS.includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    sfx.unlock();
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (e.repeat) return;
    if (ACTION_KEYS.includes(e.code)) primaryAction();
    else if (e.code === 'KeyP' || e.code === 'Escape') togglePause();
    else if (e.code === 'KeyM') toggleMute();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.code] = false; });
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    for (const k in keys) keys[k] = false;
    autoPause();
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) autoPause(); });

  // The paddle centre follows the pointer anywhere in the window.
  function pointerToGameX(clientX) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  }
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    pointer.x = pointerToGameX(e.clientX);
    pointer.moved = true;
  });
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    sfx.unlock();
    pointer.x = pointerToGameX(e.clientX);
    pointer.moved = true;
    primaryAction();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());

  // ===========================================================================
  // Update
  // ===========================================================================
  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;
    if (toast && (toast.t -= dt) <= 0) toast = null;
    if (state === 'paused') return;
    stateTime += dt;
    levelTime += dt;
    updateEffects(dt);

    switch (state) {
      case 'title':
      case 'serve':
        movePaddle(dt);
        stickBallToPaddle();
        break;
      case 'play':
        movePaddle(dt);
        updateBall(dt);
        break;
      case 'dying':
        movePaddle(dt);
        if (stateTime >= 1.1) {
          if (lives > 0) {
            resetBall();
            setState('serve');
          } else {
            endGame('gameOver');
          }
        }
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        movePaddle(dt);
        if (stateTime >= 3) nextLevel();
        break;
      case 'win':
        updateFireworks(dt);
        break;
    }
  }

  // Keyboard nudges the paddle; a mouse move jumps it straight to the pointer.
  function movePaddle(dt) {
    const dir = (rightHeld() ? 1 : 0) - (leftHeld() ? 1 : 0);
    paddle.x += dir * PADDLE_KEY_SPEED * dt;
    if (pointer.moved) {
      paddle.x = pointer.x - paddle.w / 2;
      pointer.moved = false;
    }
    paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x, 0, W - paddle.w);
  }

  function updateBall(dt) {
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt) / SUBSTEP));
    for (let i = 0; i < steps && state === 'play'; i++) stepBall(dt / steps);
    if (state === 'play') trail.push({ x: ball.x, y: ball.y, t: time });
    while (trail.length && time - trail[0].t > 0.12) trail.shift();
  }

  function bricksTouchingBall() {
    const left = ball.x - BALL_R, right = ball.x + BALL_R;
    const top = ball.y - BALL_R, bottom = ball.y + BALL_R;
    return bricks.filter((b) => b.alive && right > b.x && left < b.x + b.w && bottom > b.y && top < b.y + b.h);
  }

  // Moves the ball one small step. Each axis is moved and resolved separately, which makes it
  // unambiguous whether a brick was hit on its side (flip vx) or its top/bottom (flip vy).
  function stepBall(dt) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
    if (ball.x < BALL_R) {
      ball.x = BALL_R;
      ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx);
      sfx.wall();
    } else if (ball.x > W - BALL_R) {
      ball.x = W - BALL_R;
      ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx);
      sfx.wall();
    }
    let hits = bricksTouchingBall();
    if (hits.length) {
      ball.x = ball.vx > 0
        ? Math.min(...hits.map((b) => b.x)) - BALL_R - 0.01
        : Math.max(...hits.map((b) => b.x + b.w)) + BALL_R + 0.01;
      ball.vx = -ball.vx;
      hits.forEach(hitBrick);
    }

    ball.y += ball.vy * dt;
    if (ball.y < HUD_H + BALL_R) {
      ball.y = HUD_H + BALL_R;
      ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy);
      sfx.wall();
    }
    hits = bricksTouchingBall();
    if (hits.length) {
      ball.y = ball.vy > 0
        ? Math.min(...hits.map((b) => b.y)) - BALL_R - 0.01
        : Math.max(...hits.map((b) => b.y + b.h)) + BALL_R + 0.01;
      ball.vy = -ball.vy;
      hits.forEach(hitBrick);
    }

    if (bricksLeft === 0) {
      levelComplete();
      return;
    }

    // Paddle: only while falling and while the ball's centre is still above the paddle's middle.
    if (ball.vy > 0 &&
        ball.y + BALL_R > paddle.y && ball.y < paddle.y + paddle.h / 2 &&
        ball.x + BALL_R > paddle.x && ball.x - BALL_R < paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      bounceOffPaddle();
    }

    if (ball.y - BALL_R > H) loseLife();
  }

  // Where the ball lands on the paddle sets the new angle: centre = straight up, edges = 60°.
  function bounceOffPaddle() {
    const half = paddle.w / 2;

    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function heartPath(cx, top, s) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx, top, cx - s * 0.5, top, cx - s * 0.5, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - s * 0.5, top + s * 0.6, cx, top + s * 0.75, cx, top + s);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx, top + s * 0.75, cx + s * 0.5, top + s * 0.6, cx + s * 0.5, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + s * 0.5, top, cx, top, cx, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // Paint styles are built once. Brick and ball gradients use object-local coordinates.
  const brickFill = (color) => gradient(0, 0, 0, BRICK_H, [shade(color, 0.35), color, shade(color, -0.35)]);
  const BRICK_FILLS = {};
  for (const key in BRICK_TYPES) BRICK_FILLS[key] = brickFill(BRICK_TYPES[key].color);
  const CRACKED_FILL = brickFill('#8a94aa');
  for (const lvl of LEVELS) lvl.bgFill = gradient(0, 0, 0, H, lvl.bg);
  const DANGER_FILL = gradient(0, H - 60, 0, H, ['rgba(255, 60, 110, 0)', 'rgba(255, 60, 110, 0.16)']);
  const HUD_LINE = gradient(0, 0, W, 0, RAINBOW);
  const TITLE_FILL = gradient(W / 2 - 280, 0, W / 2 + 280, 0, RAINBOW);
  const PADDLE_FILL = gradient(0, PADDLE_Y, 0, PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H, ['#a8f4ff', '#2bb8f5', '#1560c0']);
  const BALL_FILL = ctx.createRadialGradient(-2.5, -2.5, 1, 0, 0, BALL_R);
  BALL_FILL.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  BALL_FILL.addColorStop(1, '#b4e2ff');
  const STARS = Array.from({ length: 70 }, () => ({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: HUD_H + Math.random() * (H - HUD_H),
    size: Math.random() < 0.15 ? 2 : 1.2,
    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    speed: 0.8 + Math.random() * 2,
  }));

  // ===========================================================================
  // Sound: a tiny synthesiser, so the game needs no audio files
  // ===========================================================================
  const sfx = (() => {
    let ac = null, master = null;
    let muted = store.get('brickBreaker.muted') === '1';

    // Browsers only allow audio after a user gesture, so this runs on key presses / clicks.
    function unlock() {
      if (!ac) {
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AudioCtx) return;
        try {
          ac = new AudioCtx();
          master = ac.createGain();
          master.gain.value = 0.2;
          master.connect(ac.destination);
        } catch (e) {
          ac = null;
          return;
        }
      }
      if (ac.state === 'suspended') {
        const resumed = ac.resume();
        if (resumed && resumed.catch) resumed.catch(() => {});
      }
    }

    function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, endFreq = 0, delay = 0) {
      if (muted || !ac) return;
      const t = ac.currentTime + delay;
      const osc = ac.createOscillator();
      const gain = ac.createGain();
      osc.type = type;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
      if (endFreq) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq, t + dur);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + 0.01);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(master);
      osc.start(t);
      osc.stop(t + dur + 0.05);
    }

    const melody = (notes, step, dur, type, vol) =>
      notes.forEach((f, i) => tone(f, dur, type, vol, 0, i * step));

    return {
      unlock,
      get muted() { return muted; },
      toggle() {
        muted = !muted;
        store.set('brickBreaker.muted', muted ? '1' : '0');
        return muted;
      },
      launch: () => tone(420, 0.12, 'sine', 0.4, 840),
      paddle: () => tone(250, 0.09, 'square', 0.3, 330),
      wall: () => tone(170, 0.05, 'square', 0.15),
      brick: (combo) => tone(523.25 * Math.pow(2, Math.min(combo - 1, 14) / 12), 0.09, 'square', 0.25),
      metal: () => tone(1250, 0.14, 'triangle', 0.35, 900),
      lose: () => tone(440, 0.6, 'sawtooth', 0.3, 60),
      levelUp: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047], 0.11, 0.16, 'square', 0.25),
      gameOver: () => melody([392, 330, 262, 196], 0.22, 0.32, 'triangle', 0.4),
      win: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047, 784, 1047, 1319], 0.12, 0.2, 'square', 0.25),
    };
  })();

  // ===========================================================================
  // Game state
  // ===========================================================================
  const paddle = { x: (W - LEVELS[0].paddleW) / 2, y: PADDLE_Y, w: LEVELS[0].paddleW, h: PADDLE_H, flash: 0 };
  const ball = { x: W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 0 };
  const particles = [], floaters = [], trail = [];

  // States: title | serve | play | paused | dying | levelClear | gameOver | win
  let state = 'title', stateTime = 0;
  let pausedFrom = 'play', pausedStateTime = 0;
  let levelIndex = 0, level = LEVELS[0], levelTime = 0;
  let bricks = [], bricksLeft = 0;
  let score = 0, shownScore = 0, lives = START_LIVES, combo = 0;
  let best = parseInt(store.get('brickBreaker.best'), 10) || 0;
  let bestAtStart = best, newBest = false, bonusLines = [];
  let time = 0, shakeTime = 0, shakeDuration = 1, shakeStrength = 0, fireworkTimer = 0;
  let toast = null;

  function setState(next) {
    state = next;
    stateTime = 0;
  }

  function buildBricks(map) {
    const cols = Math.max(...map.map((row) => row.length));
    const bw = Math.floor((W - 2 * SIDE_MARGIN - (cols - 1) * BRICK_GAP) / cols);
    const left = Math.floor((W - (cols * bw + (cols - 1) * BRICK_GAP)) / 2);
    const list = [];
    map.forEach((row, r) => {
      [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
        const type = BRICK_TYPES[ch];
        if (!type) return;
        const hits = type.hits || 1;
        list.push({
          x: left + c * (bw + BRICK_GAP),
          y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
          w: bw, h: BRICK_H,
          type: ch, color: type.color, points: type.points,
          hits, maxHits: hits, alive: true, flash: 0, crack: null,
          delay: r * 0.05 + Math.abs(c - (cols - 1) / 2) * 0.02,   // drop-in order: top centre first
        });
      });
    });
    return list;
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Game flow
  // ===========================================================================
  function startGame() {
    score = 0;
    shownScore = 0;
    lives = START_LIVES;
    bestAtStart = best;
    newBest = false;
    loadLevel(0);
    setState('serve');
  }

  function nextLevel() {
    loadLevel(levelIndex + 1);
    setState('serve');
  }

  function loadLevel(index) {
    levelIndex = index;
    level = LEVELS[index];
    bricks = buildBricks(level.map);
    bricksLeft = bricks.length;
    levelTime = 0;
    paddle.w = level.paddleW;
    paddle.x = (W - paddle.w) / 2;
    particles.length = 0;
    floaters.length = 0;
    resetBall();
  }

  function resetBall() {
    ball.speed = level.speed;
    ball.vx = 0;
    ball.vy = 0;
    combo = 0;
    trail.length = 0;
    stickBallToPaddle();
  }

  function stickBallToPaddle() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R - 1;
  }

  function launchBall() {
    // Launch towards the steering direction if a key is held, otherwise randomly left or right.
    let dir = (rightHeld() ? 1 : 0) - (leftHeld() ? 1 : 0);
    if (!dir) dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
    const angle = dir * (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.25);
    ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    setState('play');
    sfx.launch();
  }

  function loseLife() {
    lives--;
    combo = 0;
    trail.length = 0;
    startShake(0.5, 10);
    burst(clamp(ball.x, 10, W - 10), H - 8, ['#ffffff', '#ff4d6d', '#ffd23f'], 32, 380);
    sfx.lose();
    setState('dying');
  }

  function levelComplete() {
    const bonus = 1000 * (levelIndex + 1);
    score += bonus;
    bonusLines = [`Level bonus  +${bonus}`];
    burst(ball.x, ball.y, ['#ffffff', '#7fdcff'], 24, 260);
    trail.length = 0;
    if (levelIndex === LEVELS.length - 1) {
      const lifeBonus = lives * 500;
      score += lifeBonus;
      bonusLines.push(`Lives bonus  ${lives} × 500 = +${lifeBonus}`);
      endGame('win');
    } else {
      setState('levelClear');
      sfx.levelUp();
    }
  }

  function endGame(result) {
    newBest = score > bestAtStart;
    saveBest();
    fireworkTimer = 0;
    setState(result);
    if (result === 'win') sfx.win();
    else sfx.gameOver();
  }

  function saveBest() {
    if (score > best) best = score;
    store.set('brickBreaker.best', String(best));
  }

  function togglePause() {
    if (state === 'play' || state === 'serve') {
      pausedFrom = state;
      pausedStateTime = stateTime;
      state = 'paused';
    } else if (state === 'paused') {
      state = pausedFrom;
      stateTime = pausedStateTime;
    }
  }

  function autoPause() {
    if (state === 'play') togglePause();
  }

  function toggleMute() {
    toast = { text: sfx.toggle() ? 'Sound off' : 'Sound on', t: 1.5 };
  }

  // Space / Enter / click: start, launch, resume or continue depending on the screen.
  function primaryAction() {
    switch (state) {
      case 'title':
        startGame();
        break;
      case 'serve':
        if (levelTime >= INTRO_TIME) launchBall();
        break;
      case 'paused':
        togglePause();
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        if (stateTime > 0.8) nextLevel();
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
      case 'win':
        if (stateTime > 1) startGame();
        break;
    }
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Input: keyboard and mouse (touch / pen work too, via pointer events)
  // ===========================================================================
  const keys = Object.create(null);
  const pointer = { x: W / 2, moved: false };
  const leftHeld = () => !!(keys.ArrowLeft || keys.KeyA);
  const rightHeld = () => !!(keys.ArrowRight || keys.KeyD);
  const ACTION_KEYS = ['Space', 'Enter', 'NumpadEnter', 'ArrowUp', 'KeyW'];
  const NO_SCROLL_KEYS = ['Space', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'];

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;   // leave browser shortcuts alone
    if (NO_SCROLL_KEYS.includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
    sfx.unlock();
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (e.repeat) return;
    if (ACTION_KEYS.includes(e.code)) primaryAction();
    else if (e.code === 'KeyP' || e.code === 'Escape') togglePause();
    else if (e.code === 'KeyM') toggleMute();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.code] = false; });
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    for (const k in keys) keys[k] = false;
    autoPause();
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) autoPause(); });

  // The paddle centre follows the pointer anywhere in the window.
  function pointerToGameX(clientX) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  }
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    pointer.x = pointerToGameX(e.clientX);
    pointer.moved = true;
  });
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    sfx.unlock();
    pointer.x = pointerToGameX(e.clientX);
    pointer.moved = true;
    primaryAction();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());

  // ===========================================================================
  // Update
  // ===========================================================================
  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;
    if (toast && (toast.t -= dt) <= 0) toast = null;
    if (state === 'paused') return;
    stateTime += dt;
    levelTime += dt;
    updateEffects(dt);

    switch (state) {
      case 'title':
      case 'serve':
        movePaddle(dt);
        stickBallToPaddle();
        break;
      case 'play':
        movePaddle(dt);
        updateBall(dt);
        break;
      case 'dying':
        movePaddle(dt);
        if (stateTime >= 1.1) {
          if (lives > 0) {
            resetBall();
            setState('serve');
          } else {
            endGame('gameOver');
          }
        }
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        movePaddle(dt);
        if (stateTime >= 3) nextLevel();
        break;
      case 'win':
        updateFireworks(dt);
        break;
    }
  }

  // Keyboard nudges the paddle; a mouse move jumps it straight to the pointer.
  function movePaddle(dt) {
    const dir = (rightHeld() ? 1 : 0) - (leftHeld() ? 1 : 0);
    paddle.x += dir * PADDLE_KEY_SPEED * dt;
    if (pointer.moved) {
      paddle.x = pointer.x - paddle.w / 2;
      pointer.moved = false;
    }
    paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x, 0, W - paddle.w);
  }

  function updateBall(dt) {
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt) / SUBSTEP));
    for (let i = 0; i < steps && state === 'play'; i++) stepBall(dt / steps);
    if (state === 'play') trail.push({ x: ball.x, y: ball.y, t: time });
    while (trail.length && time - trail[0].t > 0.12) trail.shift();
  }

  function bricksTouchingBall() {
    const left = ball.x - BALL_R, right = ball.x + BALL_R;
    const top = ball.y - BALL_R, bottom = ball.y + BALL_R;
    return bricks.filter((b) => b.alive && right > b.x && left < b.x + b.w && bottom > b.y && top < b.y + b.h);
  }

  // Moves the ball one small step. Each axis is moved and resolved separately, which makes it
  // unambiguous whether a brick was hit on its side (flip vx) or its top/bottom (flip vy).
  function stepBall(dt) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
    if (ball.x < BALL_R) {
      ball.x = BALL_R;
      ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx);
      sfx.wall();
    } else if (ball.x > W - BALL_R) {
      ball.x = W - BALL_R;
      ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx);
      sfx.wall();
    }
    let hits = bricksTouchingBall();
    if (hits.length) {
      ball.x = ball.vx > 0
        ? Math.min(...hits.map((b) => b.x)) - BALL_R - 0.01
        : Math.max(...hits.map((b) => b.x + b.w)) + BALL_R + 0.01;
      ball.vx = -ball.vx;
      hits.forEach(hitBrick);
    }

    ball.y += ball.vy * dt;
    if (ball.y < HUD_H + BALL_R) {
      ball.y = HUD_H + BALL_R;
      ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy);
      sfx.wall();
    }
    hits = bricksTouchingBall();
    if (hits.length) {
      ball.y = ball.vy > 0
        ? Math.min(...hits.map((b) => b.y)) - BALL_R - 0.01
        : Math.max(...hits.map((b) => b.y + b.h)) + BALL_R + 0.01;
      ball.vy = -ball.vy;
      hits.forEach(hitBrick);
    }

    if (bricksLeft === 0) {
      levelComplete();
      return;
    }

    // Paddle: only while falling and while the ball's centre is still above the paddle's middle.
    if (ball.vy > 0 &&
        ball.y + BALL_R > paddle.y && ball.y < paddle.y + paddle.h / 2 &&
        ball.x + BALL_R > paddle.x && ball.x - BALL_R < paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      bounceOffPaddle();
    }

    if (ball.y - BALL_R > H) loseLife();
  }

  // Where the ball lands on the paddle sets the new angle: centre = straight up, edges = 60°.
  function bounceOffPaddle() {
    const half = paddle.w / 2;
    const offset = clamp((ball.x - (paddle.x + half)) / (half + BALL_R / 2), -1, 1);
    const angle = offset * MAX_BOUNCE;
    ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R - 0.01;
    paddle.flash = 1;
    combo = 0;
    sfx.paddle();
  }

  function hitBrick(b) {
    b.flash = 1;
    const cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
    if (--b.hits > 0) {                  // a tough brick survives this hit
      score += 10;
      if (!b.crack) b.crack = makeCrack(b.w, b.h);
      floaters.push({ x: cx, y: cy, text: '+10', color: '#e6ebff', life: 0.6, max: 0.6 });
      burst(cx, cy, ['#ffffff', '#b9c3d6'], 6, 140, b);
      sfx.metal();
      return;
    }
    b.alive = false;
    bricksLeft--;
    combo++;
    score += b.points;
    floaters.push({ x: cx, y: cy, text: `+${b.points}`, color: shade(b.color, 0.45), life: 0.9, max: 0.9 });
    burst(cx, cy, [b.color, shade(b.color, 0.5)], 16, 220, b);
    setBallSpeed(Math.min(ball.speed + 3, level.maxSpeed));
    sfx.brick(combo);
  }

  function setBallSpeed(speed) {
    const current = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
    ball.speed = speed;
    if (current > 0) {
      ball.vx *= speed / current;
      ball.vy *= speed / current;
    }
  }

  function makeCrack(w, h) {
    const points = [];
    let x = w * (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4);
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      points.push([clamp(x, 4, w - 4), (h * i) / 4]);
      x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18;
    }
    return points;
  }

  // ---- Effects ----
  function burst(x, y, colors, count, power, rect = null) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = power * (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7);
      const life = 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.5;
      particles.push({
        x: rect ? rect.x + Math.random() * rect.w : x,
        y: rect ? rect.y + Math.random() * rect.h : y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s - power * 0.35,
        life, max: life,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
        color: colors[(Math.random() * colors.length) | 0],
      });
    }
    if (particles.length > 600) particles.splice(0, particles.length - 600);
  }

  function startShake(duration, strength) {
    shakeTime = shakeDuration = duration;
    shakeStrength = strength;
  }

  function updateEffects(dt) {
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        particles[i] = particles[particles.length - 1];
        particles.pop();
        continue;
      }
      p.vy += 650 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
    }
    for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const f = floaters[i];
      f.life -= dt;
      if (f.life <= 0) floaters.splice(i, 1);
      else f.y -= 40 * dt;
    }
    for (const b of bricks) if (b.flash > 0) b.flash = Math.max(0, b.flash - dt * 6);
    paddle.flash = Math.max(0, paddle.flash - dt * 5);
    shakeTime = Math.max(0, shakeTime - dt);
    if (shownScore < score) {           // the HUD score counts up to the real score
      shownScore = Math.min(score, shownScore + Math.max(1, Math.ceil((score - shownScore) * Math.min(1, dt * 10))));
    }
  }

  function updateFireworks(dt) {
    fireworkTimer -= dt;
    if (fireworkTimer > 0) return;
    fireworkTimer = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.35;
    const color = RAINBOW[(Math.random() * RAINBOW.length) | 0];
    burst(120 + Math.random() * (W - 240), 140 + Math.random() * 200, [color, '#ffffff'], 40, 300);
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Rendering
  // ===========================================================================
  function render() {
    ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.height / H, 0, 0);
    drawBackground();

    ctx.save();
    if (shakeTime > 0) {
      const k = shakeStrength * (shakeTime / shakeDuration);
      ctx.translate((Math.random() * 2 - 1) * k, (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * k);
    }
    drawBricks();
    drawPaddle();
    if (ballVisible()) drawBall();
    if (state !== 'win') drawParticles();   // the win screen draws its fireworks above the overlay
    drawFloaters();
    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();
    drawOverlay();
    drawToast();
    updateCursor();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    ctx.fillStyle = level.bgFill;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120, 140, 255, 0.06)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = 40; x < W; x += 40) { ctx.moveTo(x, HUD_H); ctx.lineTo(x, H); }
    for (let y = HUD_H + 40; y < H; y += 40) { ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); }
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfd8ff';
    for (const s of STARS) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15 + 0.4 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * s.speed + s.phase));
      ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    ctx.fillStyle = DANGER_FILL;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 60, W, 60);
  }

  function drawBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      const p = clamp((levelTime - b.delay) / 0.3, 0, 1);   // drop-in animation progress
      if (p === 0) continue;
      const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = ease;
      ctx.translate(b.x, b.y - (1 - ease) * 26);
      drawBrick(b);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawBrick(b) {
    const { w, h } = b;
    const silver = b.maxHits > 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = silver && b.hits < b.maxHits ? CRACKED_FILL : BRICK_FILLS[b.type];
    roundRect(0, 0, w, h, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';     // glossy top
    roundRect(3, 2, w - 6, 5, 2.5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)';          // shaded bottom lip
    ctx.fillRect(3, h - 4, w - 6, 2);

    if (silver) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      roundRect(3.5, 3.5, w - 7, h - 7, 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40, 48, 66, 0.6)';      // rivets
      ctx.fillRect(7, h / 2 - 1.5, 3, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(w - 10, h / 2 - 1.5, 3, 3);
      if (b.crack) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20, 24, 38, 0.85)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        b.crack.forEach(([x, y], i) => (i ? ctx.lineTo(x, y) : ctx.moveTo(x, y)));
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    if (b.flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${b.flash * 0.75})`;
      roundRect(0, 0, w, h, 4);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawPaddle() {
    const { x, y, w, h } = paddle;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(70, 200, 255, 0.8)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 18 * pxScale;
    ctx.fillStyle = PADDLE_FILL;
    roundRect(x, y, w, h, h / 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)';
    roundRect(x + 8, y + 2.5, w - 16, 3, 1.5);
    ctx.fill();
    if (paddle.flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${paddle.flash * 0.6})`;
      roundRect(x, y, w, h, h / 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function ballVisible() {
    const s = state === 'paused' ? pausedFrom : state;
    return s === 'title' || s === 'serve' || s === 'play';
  }

  function drawBall() {
    for (const p of trail) {
      const k = 1 - (time - p.t) / 0.12;
      if (k <= 0) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(150, 215, 255, ${0.28 * k})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, BALL_R * (0.4 + 0.6 * k), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ball.x, ball.y);
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(170, 225, 255, 0.95)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 16 * pxScale;
    ctx.fillStyle = BALL_FILL;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  }

  function drawFloaters() {
    ctx.font = `800 15px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    for (const f of floaters) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(f.life / f.max, 0, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
      ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#070a1f';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = HUD_LINE;
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H - 2, W, 2);

    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
    ctx.font = `600 11px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7f88bd';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE', 20, 18);
    ctx.fillText('BEST', 160, 18);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('LEVEL', W / 2, 18);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES', W - 20, 18);

    ctx.font = `bold 21px ${MONO}`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText(String(shownScore).padStart(6, '0'), 20, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9aa3dd';
    ctx.fillText(String(Math.max(best, score)).padStart(6, '0'), 160, 40);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText(`${levelIndex + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, 40);

    for (let i = 0; i < START_LIVES; i++) {
      heartPath(W - 28 - (START_LIVES - 1 - i) * 24, 25, 16);
      if (i < lives) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4d6d';
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- Overlays & text ----
  function dim(alpha) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(4, 6, 20, ${alpha})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
  }

  function text(str, x, y, size, color, weight = 600, align = 'center') {
    ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.textAlign = align;
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(str, x, y);
  }

  function glowText(str, y, size, color, glow) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 24 * pxScale;
    text(str, W / 2, y, size, color, 900);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function blinkText(str, y) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(time * 5);
    text(str, W / 2, y, 17, '#ffffff', 700);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    switch (state) {
      case 'title':
        drawTitleScreen();
        break;
      case 'serve':
      case 'play':
        drawLevelBanner();
        if (state === 'serve' && levelTime >= INTRO_TIME) blinkText('CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO LAUNCH', 475);
        break;
      case 'paused':
        dim(0.6);
        glowText('PAUSED', 280, 56, '#ffffff', 'rgba(120, 160, 255, 0.9)');
        text('Press P / Esc or click to resume', W / 2, 340, 18, '#c3c9f0');
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        dim(0.5);
        glowText(`LEVEL ${levelIndex + 1} CLEAR!`, 250, 54, '#3ddc84', 'rgba(61, 220, 132, 0.8)');
        bonusLines.forEach((line, i) => text(line, W / 2, 312 + i * 30, 20, '#ffd23f', 700));
        text(`Get ready for level ${levelIndex + 2}…`, W / 2, 372, 17, '#c3c9f0');
        if (stateTime > 0.8) blinkText('CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE', 440);
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
        dim(0.7);
        glowText('GAME OVER', 230, 64, '#ff4d6d', 'rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.85)');
        drawResults(305);
        if (stateTime > 1) blinkText('CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO PLAY AGAIN', 440);
        break;
      case 'win':
        dim(0.5);
        drawParticles();
        glowText('YOU WIN!', 200, 68, '#ffd23f', 'rgba(255, 210, 63, 0.85)');
        bonusLines.forEach((line, i) => text(line, W / 2, 262 + i * 28, 18, '#c3c9f0'));
        drawResults(345);
        if (stateTime > 1) blinkText('CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO PLAY AGAIN', 450);
        break;
    }
  }

  function drawLevelBanner() {
    if (levelTime >= 2.8) return;
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(Math.min(levelTime / 0.25, (2.8 - levelTime) / 0.6), 0, 1);
    glowText(`LEVEL ${levelIndex + 1}`, 385, 48, '#ffffff', 'rgba(120, 170, 255, 0.9)');
    text(`${level.name.toUpperCase()}  ·  ${level.tip}`, W / 2, 425, 16, '#aab2e8');
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawResults(y) {
    text(`FINAL SCORE  ${score}`, W / 2, y, 28, '#ffffff', 800);
    if (newBest) text('★  NEW BEST SCORE  ★', W / 2, y + 40, 18, '#ffd23f', 700);
    else text(`Best  ${best}`, W / 2, y + 40, 17, '#9aa3dd');
  }

  function drawTitleScreen() {
    dim(0.72);
    glowText('BRICK BREAKER', 150, 66, TITLE_FILL, 'rgba(255, 90, 170, 0.55)');
    text('Clear both levels — you have 3 lives', W / 2, 200, 18, '#c3c9f0', 500);

    const x = 150, y = 232, w = 500, h = 150;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
    roundRect(x, y, w, h, 12);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(140, 160, 255, 0.25)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
    const rows = [
      ['MOUSE', 'Move to steer  ·  Click to launch'],
      ['KEYBOARD', '← → or A / D to steer  ·  Space to launch'],
      ['PAUSE', 'P or Esc'],
      ['SOUND', `M  (currently ${sfx.muted ? 'off' : 'on'})`],
    ];
    rows.forEach(([key, desc], i) => {
      const rowY = y + 30 + i * 30;
      text(key, x + 120, rowY, 13, '#7fdcff', 700, 'right');
      text(desc, x + 138, rowY, 15, '#e6e9ff', 500, 'left');
    });

    blinkText('CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO START', 440);
    if (best > 0) text(`Best score  ${best}`, W / 2, 482, 15, '#8f97c9', 500);
  }

  function drawToast() {
    if (!toast) return;
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(toast.t / 0.3, 0, 1);
    ctx.font = `700 14px ${FONT}`;
    const w = ctx.measureText(toast.text).width + 36;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 24, 60, 0.92)';
    roundRect(W / 2 - w / 2, HUD_H + 12, w, 30, 15);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(140, 160, 255, 0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(toast.text, W / 2, HUD_H + 27);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  let cursorHidden = false;
  function updateCursor() {
    const hide = state === 'serve' || state === 'play' || state === 'dying';
    if (hide !== cursorHidden) {
      cursorHidden = hide;
      canvas.style.cursor = hide ? 'none' : '';
    }
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Sizing & main loop
  // ===========================================================================
  // Fit the 4:3 game into the window and render at the screen's pixel density.
  function resize() {
    const fit = Math.min((window.innerWidth - 16) / W, (window.innerHeight - 16) / H);
    const cssW = Math.max(160, Math.floor(W * fit));
    const cssH = Math.round((cssW * H) / W);
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2560 / cssW);   // cap the backing-store size
    canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
    canvas.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
    pxScale = canvas.width / W;
  }

  let lastTime = 0;
  function frame(now) {
    const dt = lastTime ? clamp((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0, 0.05) : 0;
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();
  loadLevel(0);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #05060f;
  }
  body {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, #161c44 0%, #05060f 75%);
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(130, 150, 255, 0.3), 0 0 50px rgba(80, 100, 255, 0.3);
    touch-action: none;
  }
  noscript {
    color: #fff;
    font: 18px system-ui, sans-serif;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600" aria-label="Brick Breaker game"></canvas>
<noscript>Please enable JavaScript to play Brick Breaker.</noscript>
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  // ===========================================================================
  // Configuration
  // ===========================================================================
  const W = 800, H = 600;            // logical game size; the canvas is scaled to fit the window
  const HUD_H = 48;                  // height of the score bar; the playfield starts below it
  const BALL_R = 7;
  const PADDLE_H = 14;
  const PADDLE_Y = H - 48;
  const PADDLE_KEY_SPEED = 720;      // px/s when steering with the keyboard
  const MAX_BOUNCE = Math.PI / 3;    // bounce angle off the paddle's edge, measured from vertical
  const BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_TOP = 100, SIDE_MARGIN = 28;
  const SUBSTEP = 4;                 // max px the ball travels per collision sub-step (no tunnelling)
  const INTRO_TIME = 0.8;            // length of the brick drop-in animation when a level starts
  const START_LIVES = 3;
  const FONT = '"Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif';
  const MONO = 'Consolas, "SF Mono", Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace';
  const RAINBOW = ['#ff4d6d', '#ff8f3f', '#ffd23f', '#3ddc84', '#2ec5f0', '#a66bff'];

  const BRICK_TYPES = {
    r: { color: '#ff4d6d', points: 70 },
    o: { color: '#ff8f3f', points: 60 },
    y: { color: '#ffd23f', points: 50 },
    g: { color: '#3ddc84', points: 40 },
    c: { color: '#2ec5f0', points: 30 },
    b: { color: '#5b7cfa', points: 20 },
    p: { color: '#a66bff', points: 60 },
    m: { color: '#ff5fd2', points: 50 },
    S: { color: '#b9c3d6', points: 100, hits: 2 },   // silver: takes two hits
  };

  // One character per brick (see BRICK_TYPES), '.' = empty.
  const LEVELS = [
    {
      name: 'The Wall', tip: 'Clear every brick',
      speed: 360, maxSpeed: 520, paddleW: 120,
      bg: ['#0b1030', '#1a0d36'],
      map: [
        'rrrrrrrrrr',
        'oooooooooo',
        'yyyyyyyyyy',
        'gggggggggg',
        'cccccccccc',
        'bbbbbbbbbb',
      ],
    },
    {
      name: 'Invader', tip: 'Silver bricks take two hits',
      speed: 420, maxSpeed: 600, paddleW: 104,
      bg: ['#150a30', '#06202c'],
      map: [
        '..S.....S..',
        '...p...p...',
        '..ppppppp..',
        '.pp.ppp.pp.',
        'SSSSSSSSSSS',
        'm.mmmmmmm.m',
        'm.m.....m.m',
        '...SS.SS...',
      ],
    },
  ];

  // ===========================================================================
  // Canvas, storage and drawing helpers
  // ===========================================================================
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let pxScale = 1;                   // device pixels per logical pixel (shadow blur ignores transforms)

  const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => (v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v);

  const store = {
    get(key) { try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch (e) { return null; } },
    set(key, value) { try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (e) { /* storage unavailable */ } },
  };

  // Mix a #rrggbb colour towards white (amount > 0) or black (amount < 0).
  function shade(hex, amount) {
    const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
    const target = amount < 0 ? 0 : 255, k = Math.abs(amount);
    const mix = (c) => Math.round(c + (target - c) * k);
    return `rgb(${mix(n >> 16)}, ${mix((n >> 8) & 255)}, ${mix(n & 255)})`;
  }

  function gradient(x0, y0, x1, y1, colors) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x1, y1);
    colors.forEach((c, i) => g.addColorStop(i / (colors.length - 1), c));
    return g;
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function heartPath(cx, top, s) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx, top, cx - s * 0.5, top, cx - s * 0.5, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - s * 0.5, top + s * 0.6, cx, top + s * 0.75, cx, top + s);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx, top + s * 0.75, cx + s * 0.5, top + s * 0.6, cx + s * 0.5, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + s * 0.5, top, cx, top, cx, top + s * 0.3);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // Paint styles are built once. Brick and ball gradients use object-local coordinates.
  const brickFill = (color) => gradient(0, 0, 0, BRICK_H, [shade(color, 0.35), color, shade(color, -0.35)]);
  const BRICK_FILLS = {};
  for (const key in BRICK_TYPES) BRICK_FILLS[key] = brickFill(BRICK_TYPES[key].color);
  const CRACKED_FILL = brickFill('#8a94aa');
  for (const lvl of LEVELS) lvl.bgFill = gradient(0, 0, 0, H, lvl.bg);
  const DANGER_FILL = gradient(0, H - 60, 0, H, ['rgba(255, 60, 110, 0)', 'rgba(255, 60, 110, 0.16)']);
  const HUD_LINE = gradient(0, 0, W, 0, RAINBOW);
  const TITLE_FILL = gradient(W / 2 - 280, 0, W / 2 + 280, 0, RAINBOW);
  const PADDLE_FILL = gradient(0, PADDLE_Y, 0, PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H, ['#a8f4ff', '#2bb8f5', '#1560c0']);
  const BALL_FILL = ctx.createRadialGradient(-2.5, -2.5, 1, 0, 0, BALL_R);
  BALL_FILL.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  BALL_FILL.addColorStop(1, '#b4e2ff');
  const STARS = Array.from({ length: 70 }, () => ({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: HUD_H + Math.random() * (H - HUD_H),
    size: Math.random() < 0.15 ? 2 : 1.2,
    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    speed: 0.8 + Math.random() * 2,
  }));

  // ===========================================================================
  // Sound: a tiny synthesiser, so the game needs no audio files
  // ===========================================================================
  const sfx = (() => {
    let ac = null, master = null;
    let muted = store.get('brickBreaker.muted') === '1';

    // Browsers only allow audio after a user gesture, so this runs on key presses / clicks.
    function unlock() {
      if (!ac) {
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AudioCtx) return;
        try {
          ac = new AudioCtx();
          master = ac.createGain();
          master.gain.value = 0.2;
          master.connect(ac.destination);
        } catch (e) {
          ac = null;
          return;
        }
      }
      if (ac.state === 'suspended') {
        const resumed = ac.resume();
        if (resumed && resumed.catch) resumed.catch(() => {});
      }
    }

    function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, endFreq = 0, delay = 0) {
      if (muted || !ac) return;
      const t = ac.currentTime + delay;
      const osc = ac.createOscillator();
      const gain = ac.createGain();

I've written `index.html`, a single-file brick breaker with no external assets. I haven't run it: executing scripts here needed approval I didn't have, so I couldn't run my automated playthrough test or open it in a browser. I checked it by reading through the code instead. **What you asked for**
- **2 levels:**
  - Level 1, "The Wall", is 6 rainbow rows of 60 bricks.
  - Level 2, "Invader", is a space-invader shape. It has a faster ball, a narrower paddle, and silver bricks that take two hits and show cracks after the first.
- **Score display:** a bar across the top shows your score, best score, level (1 / 2) and lives. Bricks are worth 20–100 points, and each cleared level adds a bonus.
- **3 lives:** shown as hearts. Losing the ball costs one; after the third it's Game Over, and you can restart from that screen or the win screen.
- **Mouse:** the paddle follows the pointer anywhere in the window. Click to start, launch the ball, resume or continue.
- **Keyboard:** ← → or A / D steer, Space (or Enter / ↑) launches, P or Esc pauses, M turns sound on and off.

**Extras I added**
- Sound effects generated in the browser, so there are no audio files.
- Particle bursts, a ball trail and screen shake when you lose a life.
- The best score is saved in the browser between sessions.
- The game pauses itself when you switch tabs or the window loses focus.
- The game resizes to fit the window and works with touch too.
